reviews.title: Nice and Quiet for Price
reviews.comment: I purchased these to upgrade my PC update, with the intent to buy more expensive ones later. But much to my surprise these fans work amazingly well. Nice air flow all the while being quiet at the same time. Plus the colors look really good. So these will be staying in the build.
reviews.author: Dan B.

reviews.title: Quality for esthetics and value for money!
reviews.comment: Connected them all to the MB and daisy chained the ARGB connectors to the MOBO then use the SignalRBG free software to harness the lightning effects in different modes, result was amazing. They’re fairly quiet and I barely notice them. ARGB was so bright than other ARGB fans available in the market. These fans are really good for their price. Better than Cosair Fans.
reviews.author: Isidro Intal Lascano

reviews.title: RGB white color is slight blue or has a blue-ish tint to it
reviews.comment: These 140mm RGB fans offer excellent airflow, making them a great choice for keeping your system cool. The RGB lighting is bright and provides a pleasing glow within the case. Impressively, at around 900rpm, these fans are whisper silent, a significant plus for noise-sensitive users. However, there are a couple of drawbacks to consider. Firstly, the white color setting exhibits a noticeable blueish tint, which might be disappointing for those seeking a true white. Secondly, the RGB connectors are quite large and may not be compatible with all fan controllers. On a positive note, the ability to daisy-chain the RGB connections simplifies cable management. Overall, these fans deliver strong cooling performance and vibrant RGB lighting, with the main caveats being the slightly off-white color and the potentially bulky RGB connectors.
